remarks: Exceptionally private and perched above a quiet cul-de-sac in Coto de Caza, this approximately 6,000-square-foot custom estate sits on nearly two acres along the community’s eastern edge, with no rear neighbor, sweeping foothill views, and a separate guest house. The 6-bedroom, 5.5-bath residence offers a traditional floor plan, five-car garage, resort-style outdoor living, and extensive upgrades throughout. A long circular driveway leads up to the main residence, where abundant windows with custom wood shutters throughout bring natural light and views into the formal living and dining rooms, family room, office, and kitchen.
